basis: Manual reference-versus-raw-output inspection, not listening review or a semantic judge. Examples illustrate failures and counterexamples, not a representative rate. Corpus-text licenses remain separate from repository code.

en.reference: BUT THEN AGAIN THAT WOULD BE D J JUST PRETTY MUCH NOT AN OPTION FOR OLDER PEOPLE WHO DON'T EVEN KNOW WHAT A SCROLL WHEEL IS

en-orukeet.text: But then again, that would be that is just pretty much not an option for older people who don't even know what a scroll wheel is.

en-granite.text: But then again, that would be that is just pretty much another option for older people who don't even know what a scroll wheel is.

en.observation: Negation changed: Granite renders NOT AN OPTION as another option; baseline preserves negation. Both also smooth the disfluency.

ja.observation: Wrong-language final: 確かに becomes That's funny. under Granite; baseline is correct. At15/5dB same parent becomes That's fine/That's one.

ja.reference: うんうんうんうんうんうん。

ja-sherpa-ja.text: うんうんうんうんうん

ja.observation: Speech omission/control marker: Granite emits raw <|nospeech|>. for repeated うん; baseline preserves five of six repetitions. Marker is retained, not silently treated as successful empty text.
Orthography remains visible: なんか/何か and 色々/いろいろ/色いろ are not normalized to equivalence; surface CER is sensitive to these differences.
Consequential lexical omission/substitution: 見習おう is replaced with ミラーを and opening そっか is lost in Granite.

ja.reference: 月一か月二ぐらいで行くんだけどそこに行くと、あのー一万歩くらい行くんだよね。

ja-sherpa-ja.text: 1100人くらいってんですけど、ここに行くと、1万歩くらいい行んだよね

ja-granite.text: 聞いてた口にくらい行くんですけどここに行くとあの一番ぽくらい行くんだよね

ja.observation: At5dB both corrupt the frequency 月一か月二. Baseline preserves the step count as 1万歩 (orthographically different from 一万歩); Granite substitutes 一番ぽ. Native digits are not rewritten for scoring.
